name: Fog
spark: The mote has no edge. Some mornings it is a point of light, and some mornings the whole room is slightly harder to see across.

hybrid.text: It is weather that came indoors and stayed. It hides what it likes and it likes you.

settled.name: Wisp of Fog
settled.text: A breath of fog that stays when the window is shut. It gathers on your shoulder when you are still and trails behind when you run.

paths.name: Fog-shroud
paths.text: It learned from you that what cannot be seen is seldom hit.

prongs.name: Ground-veil
prongs.text: It lies over the whole party on the approach. The pack smells you and cannot find you.

finishes.name: Smuggler's Weather
finishes.text: Nobody sees the passenger arrive. The house's man counts you twice and then stops asking.

finishes.name: Harbour Fog
finishes.text: It comes in round the cohort like a tide when one of you is hurt, and what was chasing loses the trail.

prongs.name: Smother
prongs.text: Blows that reach you through it arrive tired. Fires that reach you through it arrive out.

finishes.name: Dousing Mist
finishes.text: It drinks your foe's element and gives back steam. Turn-fire is a thing it finds delicious.

finishes.name: Grey Pall
finishes.text: When you are down it settles over you, grey and close. Nothing has yet come through it to finish the work.

prongs.name: Standing Fog
prongs.text: Told to stay, it stays: a wall with no stones in it. Things walk in and walk out the way they came.

finishes.name: Fog-bank
finishes.text: It sits on a post like weather on a hill. The line's dark has learned it cannot see what it is attacking.

finishes.name: Sea-fret
finishes.text: It comes in off the water faster than a walking pace, and stays till you are across.

paths.name: Creeping Chill
paths.text: It learned from you that cold and wet will do a foe's work for it, given time.

prongs.name: Choke-damp
prongs.text: It goes down the foe's throat as the foe breathes in to roar. The roar is smaller.

finishes.name: Black Damp
finishes.text: In the deep places it sinks to the floor and waits there. Things that live low stop living low.

finishes.name: Drowning Air
finishes.text: Close to, it is as thick as water. The foe swings as if wading.

prongs.name: Night-frost
prongs.text: It settles at night on whatever stands still, and by morning that thing is white and slow.

finishes.name: Hoar
finishes.text: Every edge it has touched wears white needles. It makes no sound. The breaking does.

finishes.name: Black Ice
finishes.text: You step aside, and it is already under the foe's feet where you were.

prongs.name: Driven Mist
prongs.text: It goes where your shot goes, a grey line across the ground, and closes behind.

finishes.name: Rising Water
finishes.text: Enough fog in one place is a river. It rises round the foe's knees, brown and patient.

finishes.name: Storm-front
finishes.text: It rolls in across open ground ahead of you, with your Pattern inside it like lightning in a cloud.

paths.name: Listening Fog
paths.text: It learned from you that fog carries sound. It has been listening to everything, for you.

prongs.name: Fog-echo
prongs.text: It gives the foe back its own voice from the wrong direction, and the foe goes to see.

finishes.name: Calling Mist
finishes.text: Something in it calls the foe by a name it answers to. You have never heard what the name is.

finishes.name: Lost-road
finishes.text: The other house's car left before yours and has not arrived. It was foggy on their road. It was not on yours.

prongs.name: Grave Mist
prongs.text: The shades of your hall walk in it at the lamp hour and can be seen. They asked it to come.

finishes.name: Mist of the Named Dead
finishes.text: It holds the shape of each shade a moment after they have gone, so you can finish what you were saying.

finishes.name: Trail-keeper
finishes.text: It hangs where a named beast has passed and shows you the print of it, hours old, in standing grey.

prongs.name: Fog of Stillness
prongs.text: It has been into the Quiet and came back thinner. It knows how to be where the field is not.

finishes.name: The Quiet's Edge
finishes.text: It marks where the Quiet begins, a grey wall you can see, so that you never again walk into it by mistake.

finishes.name: Sudden Clearing
finishes.text: At the instant you parry it lifts, and the foe is standing in plain light with its guard open.
